title: Navigation bar
summary: Logo left, links next to it, button pushed right with margin-left: auto.
explanation: The nav is a flex row; align-items: center lines up items of different heights, and gap spaces them without margins on every child.
margin-left: auto on the last item soaks up all free space to its left, pushing it to the far edge. It is the flexbox way to split a row into groups.
The list is itself a flex container: flex layouts nest freely.
tryThis: Shrink the preview to 375px and add flex-wrap: wrap to .nav.
